info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Tax Administration API
info.description: The Enterprise Tax Administration API provides access to a comprehensive suite of tools for managing enterprise-level tax processes. Users can retrieve information on tax regulations, track payments, and manage compliance across various jurisdictions. This API is designed for financial institutions, enterprises, and tax professionals looking to streamline their tax administration efforts. With this API, developers can integrate essential tax functionalities into their applications, ensuring accurate and timely tax management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch information related to enterprise tax administration, including relevant regulations, procedures, and important deadlines to ensure compliance.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving enterprise tax administration information. This request should provide all necessary parameters in JSON format to ensure a successful operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning enterprise tax administration data.
